Response.Say: Hey! This is Alex from Bartholomew. Saw your team is building with autonomous agents in production. Did I catch you in the middle of something?

We built Bartholomew, an open source in-process AST security runtime and firewall for AI agents. When agents execute terminal, code, or SQL tools, prompt injections or hallucinations can run destructive commands like rm -rf or drop tables. Our engine intercepts and blocks dangerous commands in under 35 microseconds before anything hits your operating system or database.

It integrates with CrewAI, LangGraph, or AutoGen in a single line of Python with pip install btp-guard. Check out the code and documentation at bartholomew dot info. Thanks for taking the call, and talk soon!
